# Replica-indexed native request boundary for pooled R437

## Result and exact dependency

PR3995 at ae29394a128ba2016919446a7377c7d75ff9c18e binds Rohan Arun's
63 PR3959 moves to the actual retained emitter, and proves the old catalogue's
replica symmetry guard fails. Its emitted-IR and slot-packing results are reused,
not rediscovered. We construct the next interface: a complete replica-indexed
request vocabulary, actual owner charts, source templates and explicit IDLE
selection. This is a source/compiler interface, not a physical caller execution
or supplier admission. PR3980 supplies the dyadic determinant and separation
checker; all actual pooled calls are checked here without replica symmetry.
The local-only follow-up on PR3959 already proves the first helper's permutation
transport and common-plan equality. We do not claim that as new work.

## Physical objects and request keys

There are 288 local calls, indexed by (stage, replica), with 659 roles each.
The absolute owner of a role is exactly the pooled template's family and route.
Requests are keyed by (kind, stage, caller replica, position), except IDLE uses
its local copy/role instead of position. The catalogue enumerates all paid
physical request sites, not one replica followed by a multiplicity factor.
Its local order is stage, replica, positive literal MOVE/COPY position; IDLE
order is the retained compiler's child, replica, local-copy order. The lazy
sequence merely constructs that finite table on demand. It does not identify
requests across replicas. In particular, different replicas can own distinct
slots of the same absolute family.

Local bases, frames, chronology and COPY/ERASE matching come from the authenticated
current unpooled R437 word; the pooled compiler changes only the declared owner
records. The existing canonical adapter verifies that literal word and local
program. For MOVE, the request family and chart come from the actual call role.
For COPY, the target is the existing private common family 28416, while its source
chart comes from the actual role. The canonical Template method retains the
rank/base/preparation construction and appends the native/common tag to a record
that now starts with schema and caller replica. All2592 ERASE guards expand to
(stage,replica,erase-position,capture-position,role,base-key).

For IDLE,  the retained compiler establishes that occupied cells form a compact
prefix of the actual pending-axis list in each (child,absolute-family). The
request base is precisely the remaining suffix, not a suffix inferred from
replica 0. The family is already absolute. `idle_identifiers(child,replica)`
selects that replica's entries exactly once; `idle_family(id,replica)` checks the
request's replica and returns its family with no extra stride. The old `idles`
interface is deliberately unavailable. An existing consumer must replace its
IDLE lookup by this explicit API before it can consume this topology.

Every request's key is checked back to its exact ordinal and every local ordinal
back to the actual caller's request vector. IDLE enumeration is checked for
coverage and uniqueness. This gives a finite constructive bijection between
paid literal sites and catalogue entries. The cardinality is 903456, consisting
of 836928 MOVE, 2592 COPY and 63936 IDLE requests, with rank mass 1808352.
The profile contains 400877 rank 2 requests and exactly one rank 14 request, so it
cannot be represented by multiplying a canonical profile by 32.

## Uniform owner separation and right action

Let D=Z[1/2]. Every actual pooled chart sigma is a 64 by64 matrix over D.
The independent reconstruction agrees with the canonical chart constructor for
all 1235 labels. Exact elimination gives determinant +1 for 236 labels and -1 for 999.
Consequently every chart is invertible modulo every odd prime and every odd
prime power. This is a finite certificate of a uniform algebraic premise, not
enumeration of all primes or GL64 classes.

For each of the 179802 unordered pairs of different roles sharing a family in
one actual call, the checker exhibits an entry of sigma_a-sigma_b that is a
unit of D. Thus the charts remain different modulo every odd prime. For any
invertible common low d0, the native packet lows are ell_a=d0 sigma_a^-1 and
ell_b=d0 sigma_b^-1; equality would imply sigma_a=sigma_b modulo q, a contradiction.
Different families are separate physical registers; same-family owners use
different low packets. All 288 actual calls are checked; no 32-fold symmetry
extension is used for this pooled source. Sequential calls may reuse these
packets and must observe the latest family state.

The address action is on the right: rho_sigma(g)=g sigma. Given native low
ell=d0 sigma^-1 modulo q and a high-digit matrix X, let g=ell+qX modulo q^w.
Canonical reduction of g sigma has low d0 and unique high matrix Y. Right
multiplication by the invertible sigma is a bijection of these complete fibres.
Its inverse uses sigma^-1. No invertibility of the high-digit matrix X is
required. Canonical quotient extraction includes carries; a permutation-only
formula cannot replace this for general rational charts. Equality of these
address maps gives equality of their pullbacks pointwise for every Boolean
function, including arbitrary dirty dependence. Correct routing therefore
transports arbitrary complete packets, conditional on the physical route
primitive realizing this specified permutation. This algebra does not execute
or price that primitive.

In groupoid terms, the objects are the typed family/low fibres and the arrows
are these invertible chart transports. The caller replica is part of the
request object even when arrows happen to use the same family. Collapsing the
objects before selecting their charts is precisely the old interface error.

## Codebook identity and complete incremental bill

For fixed q let L=|GL64(F_q)|. The old vocabulary had 28233 requests and source
code limit 2*28233*L. The new one has 903456=32*28233 requests and limit 32 times
larger. Since ceil(log2(32x))=5+ceil(log2 x), the exact fixed source-code width
increases by five bits for every fixed odd prime q. At q=3 this is 6507→6512.
This is code-field width, not a claim that all physical descriptor layouts grow
by only five cells: any layout depending on that width must be recompiled and
charged. The lazy host-side representation gives no free run-time compression.

A source handle contains schema, source-codebook identity and integer code.
The identity binds q, dimension, request cardinality, code width, the exact retained
low-code codec, the authenticated unpooled request digest and exact pooled move
bytes. Cross-prime handles are rejected as well. The supplied Specifications must be bound to the same catalogue object.
A stale/untyped handle or mismatched Specifications context is rejected before the canonical source
compiler. The new Template record also includes replica and schema; successful
compilation of one integer under a different context cannot be mistaken for
historical source compatibility. Fixed-context integer codes remain internal
to the retained Specifications implementation. Handles are an interface check,
not a new authenticated physical serialization protocol. The fixed codebook
identity can be a static compilation parameter; if serialized dynamically,
its scan/storage cost remains additional and must be charged.

The exact event multiplicities remain, per low class, 189792 local gathers and
189792 local scatters,63936 IDLE gathers and 63936 IDLE scatters, and 379584 local
routes. With N low classes and completed tariffs G,S,R, the complete owner
transport term is 253728N(G+S)+379584NR. Neither the new table nor the separation
proof removes any route/scan. The request rank profile changes exactly as in
PR3995; COPY reads, paid child transforms, native preparation, private lifetime,
ERASE, dirty restoration, bridges, exchange, parking and full source consumers
remain separately charged. A complete caller bound must also replace each old
source-code width by width+5 in every descriptor, header, history checkpoint,
serialization and scanner where that field is present, re-evaluate alignment,
and sum the actual read/write/rewind rates. In the retained records.py grammar, STEP length is c=Q+2I+90 and
Program length P_h=2I+L+6+h*c; the exact increment is therefore 5h symbols
per Program. Each raw field has length Q+2+4096(L+1), increasing by 5.
With n_f raw fields and a Program with h steps, this contributes exactly
5(n_f+h) extra source-code symbols before checkpoint encoding and repeated
consumption. In the fixed four-symbol parking codec credited to PR3983, a
chronological depth-d Program stack starting at h_0 incurs 20[d*h_0+d(d-1)/2]
extra parked body symbols. Root record lengths are unchanged when I,L are
fixed. Alignment and any changed I,L require separate recomputation.
The count of those occurrences,
primitive tariffs and whole-run visited-cell reserve are unknown here. This is
an exact incremental interface invoice with explicit unknowns, not a complete
numerical physical cost bound.

## Evidence and limits

The verifier compiles representative actual q=3 specifications: the relocated
MOVE in common and native form, the unique pooled rank 14 IDLE,  and actual COPY.
Their typed records, ranks and replica identities are checked. This is finite
source compilation, not execution on a shortened or production-volume packet.
The all-q statement concerns the chart and owner-separation algebra; the complete
supplier and all its source/child/physical obligations remain conditional.
Negative controls reject omitted replica, wrong IDLE replica, legacy enumeration,
replica-factorized profile, duplicate chart, stale/cross-prime codebook, untyped source and
native COPY. No kappa/frontier change is asserted.
